kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نحترس (form VIII)
# نَحْتَرِسُ (naḥtarisu) /naħ.ta.ri.su/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَرَسَ (iḥtarasa)
# نَحْتَرِسَ (naḥtarisa) /naħ.ta.ri.sa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَرَسَ (iḥtarasa)
# نَحْتَرِسْ (naḥtaris) /naħ.ta.ris/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِحْتَرَسَ (iḥtarasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
